albums.blurb: Rival Consoles is Ryan Lee West, a London producer and one of the founding signings of Erased Tapes, the label also home to Nils Frahm and Ólafur Arnalds. Persona, named after the Ingmar Bergman film, arrived in April 2018 as the follow-up to Howl (2015) and Night Melody (2016), and it is entirely instrumental: analogue synthesizers and warped acoustic textures moving between techno pulse and quieter ambient passages.
albums.reception: Persona holds a Metacritic score of 88 out of 100, indicating universal acclaim from critics.

albums.blurb: Emotion is Jepsen's third studio album and the record that rebuilt her career after the "Call Me Maybe" phenomenon: three years in the making, deliberately modeled on 1980s pop, and made with collaborators including Dev Hynes, Ariel Rechtshaid, and Vampire Weekend's Rostam Batmanglij. It was released in Japan in June 2015 and internationally that August, led by the singles "I Really Like You" and "Run Away with Me."
albums.reception: Multiple outlets, including Time and Entertainment Weekly, named Emotion the best pop album of 2015, and it reached the top ten of the albums charts in Canada and Australia.

albums.blurb: Altın Gün is an Amsterdam-based six-piece founded by Dutch bassist Jasper Verhulst with Turkish-born vocalists Merve Daşdemir and Erdinç Ecevit, reviving the Anatolian rock tradition of 1960s–70s Turkey — folk repertoire from writers like Aşık Veysel run through fuzz guitar, saz, and funk rhythm sections. Gece ("night"), their second album after 2018's On, was released in April 2019 on ATO Records.
albums.reception: Gece was nominated for Best World Music Album at the 62nd Grammy Awards in 2020.
